guidedMatchConversation.title: Conversation guide
guidedMatchConversation.description: Use these optional stages to clarify the exchange. Free conversation always remains available.
guidedMatchConversation.saveError: The stage could not be saved. The conversation is still available — please try again.
guidedMatchConversation.quickRepliesDescription: Choose a prompt to place it in the message field. Nothing is sent automatically.

quickReplies.interested: I am interested in this exchange. Can we discuss the details?
quickReplies.condition: Could you describe the item's condition and mention any defects or missing parts?
quickReplies.offer: What would you like to receive in exchange?
quickReplies.local: I would prefer a local meetup in a safe public place.
quickReplies.courier: Courier delivery also works for me. How should we organize it?

guidedMatchConversation.refusalDescription: Insert a respectful response without rejecting or closing the match automatically.

refusals.notRightFit: Thank you for the proposal. I do not think this exchange is the right fit for me, but I appreciate your interest.
refusals.needTime: Thank you for the proposal. I need a little more time before deciding, and I will return to the conversation when I am ready.
refusals.preferDifferent: Thank you for your interest. At the moment I am looking for a different type of exchange, but I appreciate the proposal.

guidedMatchConversation.draftNotice: Inserted text remains editable in your draft. Review it before pressing Send.

matchAgreement.title: Shared agreement summary
matchAgreement.description: Write the terms you both understand. Each participant confirms the same saved revision separately.
matchAgreement.saveError: The agreement could not be updated. It may have changed in the meantime — review the current revision and try again.
matchAgreement.resetNotice: Saving any change creates a new revision and clears previous confirmations.
matchAgreement.noSideEffects: Confirmation does not create an Exchange, send a message, change the match status, or award tokens.

fields.offer: What each participant gives and receives

status.awaitingYourConfirmation: Review and confirm the saved revision
